text_to_sha256.description: Convert any input string to its SHA256 hexadecimal hash.

celsius_to_fahrenheit.description: Convert Celsius temperature(s) to Fahrenheit. Accepts a single numeric value or an iterable of numeric values.

get_products_summary.description: Fetch products table and return per-category product count and average unit_price. Supports passing pre-fetched rows or querying the DB via db_helper. Parameters: limit=None, round_digits=2, return_df=False, rows=None. Returns list[dict] or pandas.DataFrame.

get_category_stats.description: Query product categories and return list[dict] with category, product_count, average_price (rounded). Uses db_helper for DB access.

plot_monthly_revenue_trend.description: Plot monthly revenue trend line chart with order count bar chart on secondary axis. Query database for completed orders in specified year.
